scripts.wasm-web-lua: cd .. && RUSTC="$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/stable-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin/rustc" rustup run stable cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p web-lua && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir crates/web-lua/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/web_lua.wasm && node crates/web-lua/scripts/bundle-wasm.js crates/web-lua/pkg
scripts.wasm-extension-lua: cd .. && RUSTC="$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/stable-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin/rustc" rustup run stable cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p extension-lua && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir crates/extension-lua/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/extension_lua.wasm && node crates/extension-lua/scripts/bundle-wasm.js crates/extension-lua/pkg
scripts.prebuild: npm run wasm-web-lua && npm run wasm-extension-lua
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx gh-pages -d dist
